sources.shortCitation: Polona, Kurier Warszawski, 18.01.1928 — review mentioning B. Kaper
sources.fullCitation: Kurier Warszawski, R. 108, nr 18 (18 January 1928), evening ed., p. 4. Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona. Review of Eliza Rozenblum’s recital. On B. Kaper: “Trzy utwory fortepianowe B. Kapera zdradzają obiecujący talent młodego autora.”
sources.title: Kurier Warszawski, 18 January 1928

sources.fullCitation: Robotnik: centralny organ P.P.S. (Warsaw), R. 34, no. 21, 21 January 1928, p. 5. Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona. Review of a piano recital by Eliza Rozenblum, mentioning B. Kaper.
sources.title: Robotnik, R. 34 no. 21, 21 January 1928

sources.fullCitation: Rzeczpospolita (Warsaw), R. 9, no. 19, 19 January 1928, p. 5. Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona. Review of Eliza Rozenblum’s recital, identifying her as a pupil of Zbigniew Drzewiecki and mentioning three piano pieces by B. Kaper.
sources.title: Rzeczpospolita, R. 9 no. 19, 19 January 1928

sources.shortCitation: Kurjer Warszawski, 1 December 1926 — Eliza Rozenblum recital notice
sources.fullCitation: Kurjer Warszawski (Warsaw), R. 106, no. 330, morning ed., 1 December 1926, p. 3. Notice presenting pianist Eliza Rozenblum as a young exponent of contemporary piano music and announcing her recital. Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona.
sources.title: Kurjer Warszawski, 1 December 1926 — Eliza Rozenblum recital notice

sources.shortCitation: Nasz Przegląd, 19 March 1925 — Eliza Rozenblum contemporary-music recital
sources.fullCitation: Nasz Przegląd: organ niezależny (Warsaw), R. 3, no. 78, 19 March 1925, p. 8. Notice announcing a recital by Eliza Rozenblum featuring contemporary works. Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona.
sources.title: Nasz Przegląd, 19 March 1925 — Eliza Rozenblum recital notice

timelineEvents.title: Performance of piano pieces
timelineEvents.label: 1928 · Piano pieces performed in Warsaw
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Eliza Rozenblum performs three unidentified piano pieces by Kaper at the Warsaw Conservatory Hall.
timelineEvents.longDescription: At the Warsaw Conservatory Hall, Eliza Rozenblum performs three piano pieces by Kaper (titles unknown).

personNameVariants.publicNote: Alternative surname spelling. The contemporary Polish press sources cited for this record use the form Rozenblum.
